invalidates.reason: Step12 v1 loaded LongCIU NIfTI volumes with nibabel and moved the 90-slice axis to the front, yielding [z,x,y]. The official LongCIU reference code uses SimpleITK.GetArrayFromImage, yielding [z,y,x]. Thus Step12 v1 evaluated a deterministic in-plane transpose of the reference image convention.
invalidates.discovered_by: post-run implementation audit against the official LongCIU repository
invalidates.scientific_interpretation: Step12 v1 metrics are retained for traceability but treated as technically invalid for external-validation claims. Step12B performs one corrected reevaluation using the official array convention only; no orientation search is permitted.
